Net Asset Value - 2016 Realisation Shares | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings UK Newswire New Login Register Net Asset Value - 2016 Realisation Shares Summary by AI BETA Close X Marwyn Value Investors reports an estimated NAV per 2016 realisation share of £4.23309 (423.3p) as at 31 October 2026 with 684,006 shares outstanding and total NAV of £2.9m; the closing mid-market price was £2.82 on 31 October 2026, a 33.38% discount to NAV. NAV moved -0.1% in October and is +5.7% year-to-date, with an inception-to-date shareholder total return of +205.8%. NAV allocation is weighted to Le Chameau (£1.5m, 49.4% of NAV), Zegona Communications (£0.6m, 21.8%), cash (£1.3m, 47.6%) and other net liabilities (-£0.5m, -18.8%).
